summary.name: deed.page
summary.one_liner: deed.page is static web hosting built for AI agents, where one PUT or POST publishes HTML or a folder to a permanent public URL with no account or email needed.
use_cases: Publish an agent's chat output or report as a shareable link
Host a quick prototype or landing page at a chosen slug
Republish scheduled reports to the same URL
Share explainers, docs, or demos as static HTML
Host a static game or interactive demo
Serve images, PDFs, or downloads under one permanent folder
summary.what_it_does: The service accepts files via one PUT or POST to its REST API, or through a remote MCP server, and returns a live URL at a slug the caller chooses. The first publish returns a bearer token that owns the slug and can update or delete the site later, with the URL staying the same. Each publish creates a version that can be listed and restored, and older versions get their own permalinks. The Free tier allows 25 sites of 25 MB each. Owners can add custom domains, set site passwords on paid plans, register signed webhooks, and view cookieless analytics including AI crawler counts.
notable: No signup, email code, or claim link; the publish response returns a bearer token that acts as the ownership key
Sites are permanent by default, with optional X-Ttl expiry
Native remote MCP server at /mcp with publish and version tools
caveats: Site passwords, more sites, larger uploads and more versions require the paid Hobby ($3/mo) or Pro ($15/mo) plans
Losing the token leaves no self-serve recovery unless a recovery email was attached beforehand
Only static files are served; no server-side code, and no team workspaces
